name: Antoine van der Lee
bio:
Antoine is passionate about contributing to the Swift community. You might know him from his weekly blog posts on SwiftLee (https://www.avanderlee.com), his newsletter SwiftLee Weekly (https://www.avanderlee.com/swiftlee-weekly-subscribe/), or his developer tools: RocketSim (https://www.rocketsim.app), an Xcode Simulator-enhancing app, and RocketTrace (https://www.rockettrace.app), an agentic static analyzer for Xcode Instruments traces. His contributions to the Apple developer ecosystem have also been recognized by Apple, where he is featured as part of the Apple Developer Community recognition program.

He particularly enjoys speaking on best practices for structuring code architecture in a way that creates sustainability, new Swift features, Swift Concurrency, and how iOS developers can be more successful in their work.

Before going indie in 2024, he led the team at WeTransfer as a Staff iOS Engineer and developed several large-scale apps since 2009 (iOS 4!). His most recent work resulted in three courses:

- From Side Project to Going Indie: https://www.going-indie.com
- The Essential Swift Concurrency Course for a Seamless Swift 6 Migration: https://www.swiftconcurrencycourse.com
- AI Fundamentals: https://www.aifundamentals.dev

You can find his videos on YouTube at https://www.youtube.com/@AvanderLee.
